title: Native open tensor representative data existence
statement:
theorem nativeOpenTensorModels_data_exists {X Z : Scheme.{u}} (j : X ⟶ Z) [IsOpenImmersion j]
    (SX : CoefficientDerivedSystemCalculus.{u, u} l E X)
    (SZ : CoefficientDerivedSystemCalculus.{u, u} l E Z) :
    ∃ (O : SystemOpenModel l E j SX.toCoefficientDerivedSystemTensors
        SZ.toCoefficientDerivedSystemTensors)
      (On : ∀ n : ℕ, FiniteOpenModel l E j SX.toCoefficientDerivedSystemTensors
        SZ.toCoefficientDerivedSystemTensors n), True

proof.text: Construct ordinary restriction/projection and cochain data on the native system and finite sites. This step contains no derived tensor choice.

For each site apply modelOfOrdinary to the restriction tensor, its naturality, right adjunction, and K-flat preservation. It supplies the derived restriction and its representative model with the prescribed ordinary comparison.

Extend each supplied simultaneous K-flat tensor model to pairs with either factor K-flat. Retain both-model compatibility and naturality, then apply normalized projection descent to obtain gamma and its two equations.
Assemble all fields of OpenTensorModel using the ordinary comparison equality. Apply the same assembly to every finite stage and choose the family of witnesses in the existential conclusion.
